trigger: I am being targeted for who I am
description: What to do if you are stopped or harassed because of your tribe, religion, sex, dressing, or gadgets.

steps.text: Stay calm and polite. Being different is not a crime, and you are presumed innocent (s.36(5)).
You have a right to move freely in Nigeria (s.41) and to be free from discrimination (s.42).
Ask calmly: 'Am I being stopped for a specific reason, or am I free to go?'
Do not consent to searches of your phone or property without asking on what authority (s.37).
Do not insult or resist. Keep your answers short and factual.
Note the officers' names, numbers, location, time, and any witnesses.
Report profiling or extortion to the NHRC or Legal Aid afterwards.
